data.command: Can you tell me about your firewall rules?

data.text:
Our firewall rules are managed by ufw (Uncomplicated Firewall) on Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS. I've configured it to be pretty permissive, but still secure. Here's a rundown of the current rules:

`sudo ufw status verbose` shows the following:

```
Status: active
Logging: on (low)
Default: deny (incoming), allow (outgoing), deny (routed)

To                         Action      From
--                         -----      ----
22/tcp                     ALLOW       192.168.1.0/24
80/tcp                     ALLOW       Anywhere
443/tcp                    ALLOW       Anywhere
22/tcp (v6)               ALLOW       192.168.1.0/24
80/tcp (v6)                ALLOW       Anywhere (v6)
443/tcp (v6)               ALLOW       Anywhere (v6)
```

The `ufw` rules are stored in `/etc/ufw/before.rules` and `/etc/ufw/rules.d/`. I've allowed incoming traffic on ports 22 (SSH), 80 (HTTP), and 443 (HTTPS) from both the local network (`192.168.1.0/24`) and anywhere else (`Anywhere`). These
